objective: Formalize otimes as the typed composition operator for lawful coupling of RT, aRT, and orientation-conditioned process structures.

trigger.unlocked_by: O_calculus promoted to typed provisional operator calculus

formal_definition.title: Formal Principle 9.X: Typed Composition Operator
formal_definition.core_definition: The operator otimes is the typed partial composition rule by which lawful process expressions couple without collapsing their role distinction.
formal_skeleton: X otimes_Y Z is defined iff Type(X), Type(Z), and Context(Y) are declared
D(X|Z) > epsilon must remain satisfied after composition unless the composition is explicitly a collapse-boundary event
closure_class(X) and closure_class(Z) must be compatible under Y
Result(X otimes_Y Z) in RT union aRT union typed_closure_candidate
X otimes_Y Z != Z otimes_Y X unless symmetry is separately proven under Y
(X otimes_Y Z) otimes_Y W = X otimes_Y (Z otimes_Y W) only inside a declared associativity domain
failure_conditions: FAIL_OTIMES_001: missing or invalid operand typing
FAIL_OTIMES_007: projection equivalence mistaken for process identity
FAIL_OTIMES_008: unproven commutativity or associativity assumed
formal_definition.anti_reification_note: otimes is not ordinary multiplication and not physical joining. It is typed lawful coupling between process expressions.

appendix_f_update.note: otimes no longer listed as incomplete missing formalism after typed partial composition rules and failure conditions were added.

success_condition.result: otimes reduced from incomplete formal debt to typed provisional composition operator.

governance_note: This patch is a formal scaffold closure only. It does not claim global associativity, global commutativity, bridge closure, or any physics application promotion.
